_comment: The products OIO actually sells. A design is artwork; a product is that artwork on one blank we chose. `primary` is the one card that represents a design inside its category — the rest surface through 'Also on' on the product page.
_scope: T-shirts only. A design is the unit of the shelf; inside it the customer picks a product (men's or women's cut), then a colour, then a size, and the price follows that choice. Both cuts should be Bella + Canvas: 175 Unisex Jersey for men's, 4067 Slim Fit Rib for women's. Fallbacks exist because 12 published designs were never given a Bella blank in the Partner Area and would otherwise vanish from the shelf entirely — see _bellaGap.
_productTypeIdsNote: A list, tried in order, first one the design actually carries wins. A single `productTypeId` still works and means exactly that blank. The list exists because the 19 designs that were never given a product range each sit on whichever tee they were uploaded onto — 210 or 812 — while the twelve full-range designs carry 175. Demanding one specific blank would have excluded two thirds of the catalogue for no customer-visible reason: they are all unisex tees.

_bellaGap: Closed for the twelve designs that used to carry only Jerzees 210 — all of them now have Bella 175 and 4067 enabled in the Partner Area. Three published designs still have no women's Bella blank and fall back to 347 (Women's Premium T-Shirt): Save the Stick - Shift Pattern, Toyota Tosco Logo, Corolla FX16. They can't be fixed with the product template, because applying a template REPLACES the selection and would wipe the Cx ink token their men's product carries (black on Shift Pattern, two-channel on the others); 4067 has to be added by hand from the All products grid, then re-inked.
_curation: Colourways are Ian's call, design by design, made against rendered contact sheets rather than colour names. `appearanceIds` is the allowlist; anything not listed is off the shelf. Where a design wants a colour the blank does not carry (yellow, orange, brown, royal blue, bright green on Bella 175), that garment colour has to be enabled in the Partner Area first — the shop currently exposes only white, black, navy, red, olive, slate and heather gray on that blank. See _wanted.

_wanted.note: Garment colours Ian asked for that the Bella 175 blank does not currently offer in this shop. Each needs enabling in the Partner Area per design before it can be allowlisted here.
